newsitem.title: USA: CBOT says Wednesday volume sets one-day record.
newsitem.headline: CBOT says Wednesday volume sets one-day record.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said Wednesday's exchange-wide volume of 1,767,296 contracts was a one-day record, beating the prior all-time high of 1,672,923 contracts set last Friday.
As with Friday's action, trading was led by the U.S. Treasury bond futures contract. T-bond futures also set a one-day volume record with 815,908 contracts changing hands.
Last Friday, T-bonds traded 813,165 contracts, which had been the previous one-day record.
